claims.claim: Pinned native PeTTa invoked the imported SWI-Prolog membrane, which read LM Studio's live HTTP/JSON catalog.
qwen-local and nemotron-local each resolved to exactly one ID present in the same live service response; no display name or exact ID is embedded in implementation code.
The optional embedding-local alias also resolved uniquely to the live Nomic embedding ID.
The three alias-to-ID mappings exist only in a mode-0600 ignored repo-local configuration file; evidence retains its hash and a summary without copying the mapping file into Git.
missing-local returned exactly unknown-model-profile, deterministically and without substitution.
A deliberately unavailable endpoint returned exactly one deterministic lm-studio-unavailable scalar and created no configuration file.
The attributable runtime process tree contained native SWI-Prolog and no Python, Janus, or py-call process or seam.
An identical repeat produced byte-identical PeTTa stdout and an identical local configuration hash.
All protected documents retained their entry hashes.

remaining_unproven_assumptions: Schema-constrained inference and model-role reliability remain unproven until G04 and G05.
embedding-local discovery proves addressability only; embedding correctness remains unproven until G06.
LM Studio remains a replaceable localhost service and no discovered model ID has constitutional preference.
